casesStatusPolicy: not-run means this acceptance requirement has no attached case-level sign-off; existing component tests are retained separately.

domains.checkpointEvidence: All seven mods plus four EnvHD packs; checksum repair and full reinstall verified.
domains.evidenceScope: Historical source/component/native/public-package evidence and owner reports; acceptance cases below are not passed by this inventory.
domains.remainingAtSnapshot: Real Deck fresh/install/repair/reinstall/uninstall on internal and SD storage; offline and interruption checks.

cases.requirement: Fresh-install all seven modules and four EnvHD packs on internal and SD storage, including a folder with spaces; verify exact inventory, notices, disc identity and executable shortcut.

Exercise healthy and one-file-corrupt Repair, missing/corrupt launch receipts, partial bootstrap state and retired-release HTTP 404 migration; preserve personal-data hashes and prove unrelated processes survive.
Full Reinstall must fetch every payload and prepare a new workspace; Uninstall must retain saves/settings/discs unless disc deletion is explicitly selected.
Interrupt download and activation, retry after network failure, reject corrupt payloads and insufficient space without activating partial data; offline maintenance gives a recoverable explanation.

cases.requirement: Launch from Desktop and Gaming Mode with controller only; repeat Steam Stop/relaunch and ensure only the intended installation game processes are managed.
Update a real campaign from an older installation, verify changed/new/removed files and saved mod choices, then Restore and reload the same campaign.
After successful preparation, cold-launch offline from internal and SD storage; distinguish first-install network requirements from offline gameplay.
Exercise cancelled/failed update and stale shortcut recovery; verify stable Desktop resolves the current checksum-matched script and retained local Restore data survives hosted retirement.

Exercise movie entry/exit, skip, pause, fallback, suspend and stalls; restore input/display state without accumulated simulation bursts.
Compare ordinary battle entry against the same save on upstream/native artwork and each module-isolation route; record latency and frame-time traces before calling a fix complete.

Measure A/V synchronization through long opening/endings and sustained gameplay with captured timing evidence; native loopback results remain separate from physical routing.

Check crop, color, aspect, detail/artifacts and audio by matched source frames; corrupt/missing replacement must recover through the supported original route.

qualificationPlanPolicy: Shared workload and scenario counts are proposed qualification procedures for controlling source scope, not new promised features or executed evidence. Owners can refine workloads with rationale and exact receipts; neither fixture success nor arbitrary case counts alone establish 10/10.
